Methods in Biostatistics

Welcome to Methods in Biostatistics

Daily class notes for both Math 150 at Pomona College: Methods in Biostatistics. The notes are based extensively on Practicing Statistics by Kuiper and Sklar.

You are responsible for reading your text. It is good and readable, so you should use it That said, you should also make sure you are coming to class and asking lots of questions.

More information and course details can be found at the Math 150 website.
